description:
Cast Mothdust Changeling by paying {U}.
Mothdust Changeling enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Lathliss.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
The Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Mothdust Changeling from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Dragon token, adding {U}.
Repeat.
